limitations: The result concerns the D=infinity slow-time limit system, not the original parabolic problem at fixed membrane diffusion or the finite-cytosolic-diffusion limit. Explicit power laws require finitely many isolated maxima with homogeneous local asymptotics. No quantitative convergence rate to the similarity profile is claimed. Originality is assessed to the best of our knowledge.
provenance: A source-specific long-time asymptotic refinement of the D=infinity slow-time limit system in arXiv:2609.20609v1. The exact positive-part representation yields a localization clock t G(sigma(t)) -> 1; homogeneous signal maxima then determine explicit temporal exponents, support scales, multiplier decay, and local self-similar peak profiles.
record_title: A localization clock and self-similar rates for the cell-polarization slow flow
